subject: Security Review — PR #47 API Rate Limiter
body:
Hi Arjun,

Reviewed PR #47. Two blockers:
1. The limiter keys on direct IP only. Behind a load balancer/NAT this throttles multiple legit users sharing an egress IP. Check X-Forwarded-For and use a composite key.
2. No protection against rotating-IP attacks. Add a per-user token bucket.

Non-blocking: add a Retry-After header; log throttled requests to the security audit trail. Context in docs/api-rate-limiting.md. Required before NEX-231 closes.

Kenji
